## Standing operator rules
Run these steps in order, one at a time for “Webhook v1 to v2 cutover.”
Any new secret reference in `config/secrets.yaml` must use `vault://ledgerly/<ENV>/<KEY>` and never an environment-variable placeholder.
Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.
Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix nightly reconciliation refund double-counting in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. Tenacity work and webhook cutover are superseded/paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
`db-prod`; database/user `payments`; `webhook_cutover_20250308`; cursor `primary`; migration `0042_add_search_vector_tenant_document.py`; sandbox B: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev` (Sandbox A superseded).

## Ruled-out approaches
Webhook-handler retry decorator resent customer emails. Changing `test_rounding_legacy_currency` addressed an unrelated failure.

## Plan and progress
- [DONE] Search rebuild and CSV UTF-8 fix; full tests pass.
- [DONE] Cutover steps 1–5; step 5 job creation exited 0.
- [PENDING] Inspect replay logs: `kubectl -n payments logs job/webhook-replay-a` (status unknown).
- [PENDING] Diagnose refund aggregation; exact next command unavailable.

CSV writer now explicitly uses UTF-8; added regression coverage. Tests: 186 passed, 3 skipped; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.
